title: Data Access with ADO.NET
description: Learn how to use ADO.NET to perform CRUD operations in ASP.NET Core applications.
longDescription: This module teaches you how to use ADO.NET for database operations in ASP.NET Core. You will learn about SqlConnection, SqlCommand, SqlDataReader, and how to build complete CRUD operations using raw ADO.NET.
whatYouLearn: Use SqlConnection and SqlCommand for database access
